method: Manual browser observations through the supported browser API; no automated domain suite.

observations.result: Published one cross-application epic, two sprints and three structured stories with acceptance criteria and member attribution.
US-002 depends on US-001. Publishing US-001 depending on US-002 was refused; correction preserved the draft and succeeded.
Epic removal of PLA was refused while US-002 still required it; correcting and publishing succeeded.
Sprint 1 activation first refused because US-001 lacked a published responsible member; adding/publishing the member enabled activation. Sprint 2 activation then refused while Sprint 1 was active.
Closure with US-002 draft refused. Publishing the draft made the prior closure balance stale; selected decisions remained visible.

US-001 carried into planned Sprint 2 with in_progress preserved; US-002 returned to backlog with assignment cleared; finished US-003 assignment cleared. Repeating from another tab returned the existing closed result.
US-001 later renamed/completed in active Sprint 2; Sprint 1 kept its old title/in_progress state. US-002 snapshot ready remained unchanged while its current revision became backlog.
Archived US-003 becomes an unavailable reader row; admin history retains all three original rows.
Restoration of the old planned Sprint 1 revision refused; closed state/snapshot unchanged.
Assigned responsible member remains user; no admin controls and direct closure/history requests denied.
Epic+backlog story list returned US-002. PLA snapshot filter returned only visible US-002. Epic detail showed current Sprint 2 and historical Sprint 1.

Closed reader page, active home and new-story form matched viewport/document width 390. Desktop closed page captured at 1280. A keyboard Right input moved table scrollLeft from 0 to 40 while document width remained 390. Mobile menu navigation worked.

limits: Activation refusal was sequential, not a simultaneous transaction race/load exercise.
No 30-minute expiry boundary or full size/assistive-technology matrix exercised.
No direct SQL corruption attempt or exhaustive closed-sprint archive/republication cycle.
No file adapter, semantic worker or chatbot shipped in M4.
